skill.name: whatsapp-automation
skill.description: Automate WhatsApp Business messaging, templates, media, profile lookup, and contact sharing through Rube MCP and Composio's WhatsApp tools.
skill.summary: Guide AI agents through safe WhatsApp Business workflows using Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, and workflow examples. One low-risk network finding is confirmed because the skill asks users to configure a remote Rube MCP endpoint. No prompt injection text or hidden executable code was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Document what data may pass through rube.app/mcp and require users to approve the remote MCP server before use.
Add an explicit step to verify recipient opt-in, lawful basis, and WhatsApp policy compliance before each send workflow.
Warn users to share contact cards only with permission and to minimize phone, email, and profile fields.

static_findings.snippet: - Active WhatsApp connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `whatsapp`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `to`: Recipient phone number in international format (e.g., '+14155551234')
- `phone_number_id`: Business phone number ID to send from
2. `WHATSAPP_SEND_MEDIA_BY_ID` - Send media using the uploaded media ID [Required]
3. `WHATSAPP_SEND_MEDIA` - Send media using a public URL [Alternative]
- `media_url`: Public URL of the media (for SEND_MEDIA)
1. `WHATSAPP_SEND_REPLY` - Send a reply to a specific message [Required]
- `message_id`: ID of the message being replied to
3. `WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBER` - Get details for a specific number [Optional]
- `contacts`: Array of contact objects with name, phone, email details
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- message_id must be from a message received within the 24-hour window
2. Extract phone_number_id for your business number
3. Use phone_number_id in all send operations

content.value_statement: WhatsApp Business workflows often need several API steps and current tool schemas. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through Rube MCP to send compliant messages, templates, media, and contacts.
actual_capabilities: Search current Rube tool schemas before using WhatsApp tools.
Verify WhatsApp Business connections through Rube connection management.
Send text, reply, and approved template messages to WhatsApp recipients.
Upload media and send media by ID or public URL.
Create, list, and check WhatsApp Business message templates.
Send contact cards with structured contact details.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP server and WhatsApp Business API connection.
Does not work with regular consumer WhatsApp accounts.
Business-initiated messages outside the 24-hour window require approved templates.
Media uploads, templates, and delivery are subject to WhatsApp and Meta limits.

use_cases.title: Resolve Customer Support Replies
use_cases.description: Send approved responses, replies, and media to customers within the WhatsApp conversation window.

use_cases.title: Run Template-Based Outreach
use_cases.description: Find approved templates, fill variables, and send policy-compliant notifications to opted-in recipients.

use_cases.title: Manage Business Messaging Assets
use_cases.description: Review phone numbers, profile details, media uploads, and template approval status before campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Send a Basic Message
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple customer message.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use whatsapp-automation to send this message to [phone number] from our business number: [message]. Confirm E.164 number format first.

prompt_templates.title: Send an Approved Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for outbound notification templates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find our approved WhatsApp templates, choose [template name], and send it to [phone number] with these variables: [values].

prompt_templates.title: Share Media With Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for image, document, or video delivery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [file or media URL], send it to [phone number] with caption [caption], and report the media ID used.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Compliant Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete messaging workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a compliant WhatsApp workflow for [audience] using approved templates, media, and reply handling. Include prerequisites, tool order, and consent checks.

output_examples.input: Send a shipping update template to a customer.
output_examples.output: The assistant checks available templates, confirms the selected language, fills the shipment variables, and sends the approved template.

output_examples.input: Upload and send a PDF invoice with a short caption.
output_examples.output: The assistant uploads the document, captures the returned media ID, sends it to the recipient, and summarizes the delivery attempt.

output_examples.input: Share a sales contact card with a customer.
output_examples.output: The assistant validates the recipient number, builds the contact card details, and sends the card after confirming permission.

best_practices: Search Rube tools first so parameters match the current WhatsApp schemas.
Verify opt-in, E.164 phone format, and template approval before sending messages.
Use template messages for business-initiated outreach outside the 24-hour window.
anti_patterns: Do not send messages to recipients without consent or a valid business reason.
Do not use public media URLs that expose private customer documents.
Do not assume a regular WhatsApp account can use Business API workflows.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It guides WhatsApp Business messaging, templates, media uploads, profile lookup, and contact sharing through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does it work with personal WhatsApp accounts?
faq.answer: No. It requires a WhatsApp Business API account connected through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does the skill send messages by itself?
faq.answer: It instructs an AI agent to use Rube MCP WhatsApp tools after checking current tool schemas.

faq.question: How are template messages handled?
faq.answer: The skill lists templates, checks approval status when needed, and sends approved templates with required variables.

faq.question: Can it send media files?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports media upload, media-by-ID delivery, and sending media from public HTTPS URLs.

faq.question: What should I verify before sending?
faq.answer: Verify recipient consent, E.164 phone format, active WhatsApp connection, approved templates, and media access controls.
